_adjudication_2026-09-06: NSE shareholdingdetails.jsp files ADR/GDR (depository receipts) under the "FIIs" heading; the BSE-derived store excludes DR from the fii slot per the project convention (excl regex, §127g, §22 — a DR block folding into FII is a RECLASSIFICATION, not a stake change). Every disagreement whose BSE page carries an ADR/GDR row is therefore the STORE being right and NSE mislabelling — confirmed on ELDERPHARM 2004-06 and SBIN 2002. This is a systematic taxonomy difference in the NSE route, not random error; it does NOT lower confidence in the 291 fills (those are quarters the store had NO cell, so no ADR/GDR double-count is possible — and the overlap gate already kept these 16 out). OPEN CONVENTION QUESTION for the user: a company holding ~30% foreign via ADR/GDR reads fii=0 while the same money reads fii~24% once converted to direct FII (ELDERPHARM 2004-06 vs 2005-03) — a fiiChgPp discontinuity that is faithful per-cell but not a real inflow. Folding DR into fii would be a site-wide convention change (same class as the Sep-2022 DR dissolution, §22) — not made here.
_audit_2026-09-07: All 16 §127k disagreements adjudicated by reading BOTH documents (BSE aspx + NSE shareholdingdetails.jsp). Classes: (a) ADR/GDR mislabel — NSE files depository receipts under FIIs, store excludes per convention, STORE RIGHT (ELDERPHARM, SBIN×3, MAARSOFTW 2003-12); (b) state-government holding NSE folds into its institutional lump but the store keeps in the govt slot, STORE convention-correct (VOLTAS×2); (c) cross-exchange filer classification of a boundary block — FII vs NRI/OCB (CEAT×3), promoter vs bank (RSSOFTWARE), or a different institutional sub-breakdown (HLVLTD, MAARSOFTW 2003-06) — small (<1.2pp), neither exchange authoritative, STORE KEEPS ITS BSE READING; (d) restated vintage — the NSE capture back-dates a post-corporate-action structure onto an old quarter (ABAN, grand total 7.38M as-filed vs 42.38M in the 2005 capture), STORE KEEPS as-filed; (e) ONE genuine defect — VXL is the wrong entity (VXL Instruments 517399 instead of Birla VXL 503796), HEALED. So of 16 disagreements, 15 confirm the store and 1 was a wrong-entity defect now fixed; none required accepting an NSE value over the store.
